title: Rat.unskip_matSkip: unskip p is a left inverse of the injection matSkip p, unconditionally
statement: Rat.matSkip p is the order-preserving injection [0,n) -> [0,n+1) whose image misses p. Rat.unskip p is declared here as its left inverse: unskip p q is q's position in [0,n+1) minus {p}. This fact records that unskip p (matSkip p k) = k for every p and k, with NO hypothesis -- unlike every other lemma in this cluster, which carries a Nat.ble premise. It is unconditional because matSkip p never produces p, so its whole image lies where unskip p inverts it, and the two branches of the guard are covered by the two branches of the recursion rather than by a case split. This is the index lemma that lets a Laplace double-expansion summand be defined as a function of the two COLUMNS: the inner cofactor column is k, but the summand has to be a function of (p, q), and k = unskip p q is how it is recovered.

formal.statement: theorem Rat.unskip_matSkip : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Eq.{1} AxNat (Rat.unskip x0 (Rat.matSkip x0 x1)) x1))

notes: The SHAPE of Rat.unskip is the finding, and it is forced. ADR-1155 names the closed form, unskip p q := if Nat.ble (succ p) q then Nat.pred q else q. That form computes the right function -- checked at all 64 pairs below 8 -- and is the wrong shape to reason with: unskip p (matSkip p c) then carries TWO stuck Nat.ble guards, and a Bool.rec split on the inner one does not reach the outer, because reducing ble (succ p) (succ c) RE-CREATES ble p c, the very scrutinee the split had abstracted away. Declared instead as a double Nat.rec -- the construction Nat.ble and Nat.beq already use -- all three rows hold by iota alone (unskip 0 q = Nat.pred q, unskip (succ p) 0 = 0, unskip (succ p) (succ q) = succ (unskip p q)) and this lemma is a two-level induction with no case split at all. That is Rat.matSkip_succ_succ's finding arriving from the other side: there a succ could not be pushed through a stuck recursor and the answer was a Bool.rec; here a Bool.rec cannot reach a guard that reduction regenerates and the answer is to make the definition structural. The same preference decides the sibling Rat.unskip_gt, stated at succ q rather than as unskip p q = Nat.pred q: the pred form's successor step ends at succ (pred q') = q' and needs a further inversion, while this form's successor step is the induction hypothesis.
